plan.title: Capability Integration — no derelict capabilities (MVP)
plan.goal: Every implementation/tool/feature integrated into agents' working memory, workflows and repertoire; none derelict, unused, stale, dead or unavailable (enabled != done).
success_criteria: aq-capability-audit UNDISCOVERABLE, STALE-CLAIM, DEAD-CANDIDATE trend to 0
every remaining capability is wired into a workflow or archived (Rule 12)

phases.name: flagship gaps
phases.goal: vector DB + understand-anything + dormant modules real

items.name: restore aq-* usage logging
items.goal: aq-usage.jsonl records every aq-* invocation again; audit uses logged use, not inference
items.validation_goal: last-30d aq-usage.jsonl non-empty after a day of normal use; audit 'used' for aq-* from usage log
items.editorial_note: MVP: enabled-for-testing is not done; acceptance is the owner's.

items.name: capability audit tool + baseline
items.goal: deterministic aq-capability-audit with 6 classes and a committed baseline
items.editorial_note: MVP: enabled-for-testing is not done; acceptance is the owner's.

items.name: audit on timer + RSI regression feed
items.goal: the audit runs periodically; worsening class transitions become RSI incidents
items.validation_goal: timer active; a synthetic regression is recorded by aq-rsi sweep
items.editorial_note: MVP: enabled-for-testing is not done; acceptance is the owner's.

items.name: agent-loaded capability index
items.goal: a generated index of every non-dead capability (name, one-line purpose, when to use) loaded via the tooling manifest, aq-hints and progressive disclosure
items.validation_goal: UNDISCOVERABLE count -> ~0 on re-audit; index regenerated by a deterministic script
items.editorial_note: MVP: enabled-for-testing is not done; acceptance is the owner's.

items.name: honest catalog/tracker claims
items.goal: the 12 STALE-CLAIM entries are corrected or wired; agent-recorded acceptances listed for owner re-review
items.validation_goal: STALE-CLAIM -> 0 on re-audit; owner review list delivered
items.editorial_note: MVP: enabled-for-testing is not done; acceptance is the owner's.

items.name: dead-candidate triage
items.goal: each of the 69 items revived+wired or archived under Rule 12, with evidence
items.editorial_note: MVP: enabled-for-testing is not done; acceptance is the owner's.

items.name: wire unused capabilities into workflows
items.goal: UNUSED-AVAILABLE items attached to hints rules, blueprints, dispatch context or skill routing
items.editorial_note: MVP: enabled-for-testing is not done; acceptance is the owner's.

items.name: vector DB integrity + routing
items.goal: collision-free ids, no drops, reconcile, knowledge/wiki routed, missing collections handled
items.validation_goal: aq-vector-reconcile shows 0 missing after backfill; knowledge hit share > 5% of searches
items.editorial_note: MVP: enabled-for-testing is not done; acceptance is the owner's.

items.name: understand-anything fully integrated
items.goal: graph refreshed and auto-kept fresh; query endpoint + agent tool; live dashboard card; Nix-pinned upstream
items.validation_goal: graph age < refresh limit; agents call graph_query in telemetry; dashboard card shows live age
items.editorial_note: MVP: enabled-for-testing is not done; acceptance is the owner's.

items.name: meta-optimization + query expansion made real
items.goal: missing migrations/routing source added; expansion flag has a consumer; then enabled for MVP testing
items.validation_goal: units succeed live; expansion telemetry shows use
items.editorial_note: MVP: enabled-for-testing is not done; acceptance is the owner's.
